method: Only main is overlaid to start and stop runtime/pprof CPU profiling. Workload and adapters unchanged; diagnostic only. Default GOMAXPROCS, CGO_ENABLED=0, GOEXPERIMENT=decimal.
caveat: Euro profile is dominated by runtime kevent/madvise samples outside the selected workload. Percentages in filtered listings retain the total-profile denominator; do not treat them as precise workload CPU shares.
